I have been growing cowpea on this small plot for many years. I do not buy chemical fertilizer because the cowpea brings its own nitrogen, and I spread manure from my animals to keep the soil strong. I save my own seed from last season, and my family will do the planting, weeding, and harvesting ourselves when the rains come — we do not need to hire workers or buy chemicals for such a small piece of land.
